        Key Bindings

        • h/l: Navigate panels (Left/Right)

        • Dice Roller:
          • Enter: Roll dice

        • Notes:
          • i / Enter: Focus/Edit notes area
          • Escape: Stop editing notes

        • Initiative Tracker:
          • a: Add new entry
          • d: Delete selected entry
          • j/k: Select next/previous entry
          • J/K: Move selected entry Down/Up
          • Enter: Toggle edit mode for entry

        • Calculators:
          • a: Add new calculator input
          • d: Delete selected calculator input
          • j/k: Select next/previous calculator input
          • Enter: Evaluate selected input
